Merge #4201 first. Then this PR shows only its own three commits (`8fd0a47ec..745234df7`), and it can merge. A review of this PR is still welcome now.

This PR is a draft again until #4201 merges. The reason is the merge order in the comment above: a merge of this PR also lands #4201, which has an open `needs-rework`. There is no code change and no new head. I will flag this PR ready again when #4201 is merged.
#4201 is merged (`903e420b3`). This PR is ready again. GitHub now shows only its own three commits (`8fd0a47ec..745234df7`). There is no new head and no code change.

Reviewer: wopr pool job review-4233, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** The PR head is green and the code is good. But the PR does not merge with `main` (`CONFLICTING`). The conflict is in code, not in a ledger. Its resolution needs new wire keys, so it is new work.

Tier: SAFETY. The open path sets the judged body bands of an assembled tool (`as_derived`). The sync derives tool records again, and a tool record changes posted G-code.

## Blocker

1. **The PR conflicts with #3646 on `main` (`3ab6f4ae3`). The resolution must save the new row fields, or a save loses data.**
   - Trial merge with `upstream/main` `afca9b8b1`: conflicts in `crates/app/src/schema.rs`, `crates/app/src/commands/tool_assembly.rs` and `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders.rs`.
   - On `main`, `DocumentComponent` now has `milling: Option<MillingBody>` and `running: Option<InsertRunning>`. `tool_assembly::derive` on `main` reads them: the cutter diameter, flutes and centre cutting of a multi-seat body, and the tool material and cutting rows of an insert.
   - This PR gives the row a third field, `library_ref`. Its wire form (`component_wire::ComponentDto`, `component_to_dto`, `component_from_dto`) writes only `id`, `name`, `item`, `geometry` and `library_ref`.
   - Failure if the conflict is resolved by "keep the two sides": a project with a multi-seat cutter or an insert with running data saves as v84 without `milling` and `running`. The reopened document derives the next tool from a row without them. The tool record (diameter, flutes, feeds) then changes with no message, and the posted program changes. That is data loss and a silent change of G-code.
   - The decision file says: "The wire form is the contract: a change to a key needs a project version step." So the keys must be in v84 before it ships. A later fix needs v85.
   - Required:
     - Merge `main` and keep `milling`, `running` and `library_ref` on the row. `DocumentComponent::new` of `main` must set `library_ref: None`, and `EditDocumentComponent::new` must keep the held `milling`, `running` and `library_ref`.
     - Add `milling` and `running` to `ComponentDto`, strict as the other keys (checked constructors, refusal by row id).
     - Put them in `content_hash`, or say in the decision file why the sync status ignores them. Decide if the library file (`camcraft-components/1`) carries them.
     - Extend `a_project_with_a_component_table_and_its_assemblies_reopens_identically` (or add a test in the same directory suite) with a multi-seat body and an insert with running data. Assert that save, open, save is byte-stable and that the next edit derives the same tools.
     - Run the quick gate on the merged head again, with `example_catalog*` and `project_roundtrip` by name.

## What looks good

- Strict, all-or-nothing reads. Each refusal names the row or the tool. The table and the stacks are read before any world write, and `a_corrupt_row_or_link_refuses_the_file_by_name` proves that nothing lands.
- An open never applies a library copy. The derived `ToolDef` and `ToolBody` stay as saved, so an open does not change a posted program.
- `SyncDocumentComponent` goes through the `EditDocumentComponent` law. One undo step restores the rows, the records and the bodies. A change of the link alone derives no tool again.
- The atomic save (temp file, then rename) removes the temp file on failure. The built-in id space is refused in a user file.
- The version step 83 -> 84 is unconditional, with `feat(tools)!:` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. The example project changes only its version line. No `.nc` or `.cl` program changed.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. Provenance lines are on each new module. The new files are under 400 lines. The new tests join the existing directory suite `tool_library_holders`.
- MCP: the body names #3647 for `SyncDocumentComponent` and the sync status. `Changelog:` line is present. `Refs #3645` is correct for a slice.

## Results (locally on wopr, PR head `745234df7`, not merged: the merge conflicts)

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base 8fd0a47ec` (the merge base): 355 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The run went in three parts, because a time limit stopped the first part after step 328 (all green). The other 27 steps (`app suites: wall_arc_entry` to `wire_verify_tol`, `ui build`, 8 `ui suites`) ran with `--only`. All green.
- This includes `tool_library_holders` (25 passed, all 9 pinning tests), `project_roundtrip`, `continuous_4axis_part`, `example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive` and `example_catalog_edge_work`.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Extra suites run: none were due. The diff changes no `testdata/` file and no importer code.
- Heavy lanes: not run. They are not a merge condition (AGENTS.md "Heavy lanes at review"). This is a P6 PR.
- Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed.

## Mutations (run by the reviewer)

- M1: the loader keeps the file body and skips `assembly_wire::as_derived` (`project/apply.rs`). RED: `a_project_with_a_component_table_and_its_assemblies_reopens_identically` (line 80) and `a_library_copy_that_differs_after_an_open_is_reported_never_applied` (line 169).
- M2: a change of the link alone derives the tools again (the `content_changed` filter in `EditDocumentComponent::with_row` removed). RED: `a_sync_pulls_a_newer_library_copy_into_both_assemblies_and_undo_restores` and `a_library_copy_that_differs_after_an_open_is_reported_never_applied` (line 125).
- M3: a hand edit drops the library link (`EditDocumentComponent::new` sets `library_ref` to `None`). GREEN: no test pins this law. See note 1.

## Optional, non-blocking

1. Add a test for "a hand edit keeps the link" (M3 survived): an `EditDocumentComponent::new` on a linked row keeps `library_ref`, and `sync_status` then gives `UpdateAvailable`. The body and the decision file state this law.
2. `component_wire::content_hash` uses `serde_json::to_vec(..).unwrap_or_default()`. If the write fails, two different rows get the same hash, and the status says `UpToDate`. The write cannot fail for these types now. A `Result` or a comment that says why it cannot fail makes the law clear.
3. `component_library/store.rs` names none of the five app concerns in its `use` lines ("`app` holds the document"). Its parent module uses the project wire, and `fixture_library::store` is the same pattern, so this is a note only.

## Labels and state

- Labels: `needs-rework` and `conflicts`.
- AGENTS.md says that a PR with an orange `conflicts` verdict is a draft. The reviewer does not edit the PR. The author can make it a draft while the merge with `main` is done.

**Merge commit `8a4ec19ff`** (merge of `origin/main` `ef6e9ed97`). Conflicts and their resolution:
- `crates/app/src/schema.rs`: both sides added fields to `DocumentComponent`. I kept the two sides: `library_ref` (this PR) and `milling` and `running` (#4249). `DocumentComponent::new` sets all three to `None`. `LibraryRef` and `InsertRunning` both stay.
- `crates/app/src/commands/tool_assembly.rs`: both sides added `with_row` with the same signature. I kept one, the `pub` form of `main` with `row_law`. `EditDocumentComponent::new` keeps the library link, the cutter facts and the running data of the held row.
- `crates/app/tests/tool_library_holders.rs`: both module lists kept.

**New code (the #4249 PR body asks for it, and it is the blocker of the review comment 7209029673):**
- `project::component_wire` writes `milling` and `running` as optional keys of the v84 row (and so of a `.camtools` v8 row). The reading is strict: an unknown key is refused. The reader applies the row law of the commands (`row_refusal`) to each row on file.
- `camcraft-components/1` does not hold the two keys. A library file with them is refused by name. `LibraryComponent::from_row` refuses a document row with them by name, so a save never loses them without a word. A sync keeps the facts and the data of the document row.
- The decision is in `docs/decisions/3645-component-library.md` (new section).

**A logic overlap that the merge did not show as a conflict (commit `5d4336bd1`):** this PR skipped the tool derive when only the library link changed. The test compared only the catalog fact and the geometry. After the merge, an edit of the cutter facts or the running data derived no tool again. The quick gate found it (`multi_seat::an_edit_that_breaks_a_seat_is_refused_by_the_tool_name` was red). The test now compares the whole row without the link.

**The two non-blocking review notes (commit `d47c7e498`):**
1. New test `component_sync::a_hand_edit_keeps_the_link_and_the_status_reports_the_difference`: `EditDocumentComponent::new` on a linked row keeps `library_ref`, and `sync_status` then gives `UpdateAvailable`.
2. `component_wire::content_hash`: a comment now says why `serde_json::to_vec` cannot fail (our own DTOs and a `Value`, string keys only, a non-finite number is written as null).
Note 3 needs no change.

**Pinning tests:**
- `multi_seat::multi_seat_rows_and_insert_running_data_save_and_reopen_identically`: a project with two multi-seat cutter rows and an insert with running data saves and reopens with the same rows and the same derived tool records, bodies and stacks, byte-stable.
- `multi_seat::a_cutter_fact_on_the_wrong_row_or_an_unknown_key_refuses_the_file`
- `component_sync::the_store_round_trips_and_refuses_a_bad_file_whole_by_name` (new asserts for the keys and `from_row`)

**Class:** DELTA + NEW CODE.

**Gates (Mac):**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` on `5d4336bd1`: 355 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (all `camcraft-app` suites and the `camcraft-ui` suites).
- `cargo xtask gate light` on `5d4336bd1`: 6 steps, 0 failed.
- On the final head `d47c7e498` (one test and one code comment more): `tool_library_holders` 86 passed, `project_roundtrip` 32 passed; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.

The coordinator set the PR to draft for the `conflicts` verdict. I flagged it ready again after the push.

Ready for a re-check.
